title: Iteration commutes with state encoding
statement: For every natural number $p$, arithmetic state $s$, and natural number $n$, applying the encoded determinant step $n$ times to the encoding of $s$ with parameter $p$ yields the encoding, with the same parameter $p$, of the state obtained by applying the determinant step with parameter $p$ to $s$ exactly $n$ times.
